import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_copy.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/now_cubit.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/screen_layout.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/data/models/app_settings.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

/// Step 3: when should we remind you.
class TimePage extends StatelessWidget {
  const TimePage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final bloc = context.read<OnboardingBloc>();
    final now = context.value<NowCubit, DateTime>();
    return BlocSignalBuilder<OnboardingBloc, OnboardingState>(
      builder: (context, state) => Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
            child: KitTopBar(
              onBack: () => bloc.add(const BackPressed()),
              center: const KitProgressDots(step: 3, count: 4),
              trailingLabel: 'Skip',
              onTrailing: () => bloc.add(const SkipPressed()),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: PinnedBottomColumn(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                KitSpace.l,
                6,
                KitSpace.l,
                KitSpace.xl,
              ),
              bottom: KitButton(
                label: 'Continue',
                onPressed: () => bloc.add(const ContinuePressed()),
              ),
              children: [
                Semantics(
                  header: true,
                  child: KitBalancedText(
                    'When should we remind you?',
                    style: KitType.title.copyWith(color: c.ink),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  'We only remind you on days an item is due.',
                  style: KitType.secondary.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.xl),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    for (final (i, preset)
                        in ReminderPreset.values.indexed) ...[
                      if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: KitSpace.gridGap),
                      Expanded(
                        child: KitPresetCard(
                          icon: const [KitIcons.sun, KitIcons.cup, KitIcons.moon][i],
                          title: const ['Morning', 'Lunch', 'Evening'][i],
                          value: AppCopy.time(preset.time),
                          selected: state.preset == preset,
                          onTap: () =>
                              bloc.add(ReminderTimeChosen(preset.time)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 28),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 4, bottom: 10),
                  child: Text(
                    'OR PICK A TIME',
                    style: KitType.overline.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                  ),
                ),
                KitTimeWheel(
                  hour: state.time.hour12,
                  minute: state.time.minute - state.time.minute % 5,
                  pm: state.time.pm,
                  onChanged: (hour, minute, {required pm}) => bloc.add(
                    ReminderTimeChosen(
                      TimeOfDayValue(hour % 12 + (pm ? 12 : 0), minute),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.m),
                KitBanner.info(
                  icon: KitIcons.drop,
                  rich: Text.rich(
                    TextSpan(
                      text: 'First reminder: ',
                      children: [
                        TextSpan(
                          text: firstReminderText(now, state.time),
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// "tomorrow at 8:00 AM", or "today at 7:00 PM" when that is still ahead.
String firstReminderText(DateTime now, TimeOfDayValue time) {
  final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day, time.hour, time.minute);
  final day = today.isAfter(now) ? 'today' : 'tomorrow';
  return '$day at ${AppCopy.time(time)}';
}
